Psychology Overview
Psychology
is a strange skill that revolves around affecting allies/enemies by getting into their head. It's one of the most versatile support skills, with a mix of crowd control, healing, and rage reduction.
In-Game Description
Understanding the mind of sentient creatures. Also, using that knowledge in combat and other stressful situations.
Training Psychology
Riger
will not directly teach you Psychology, but after you complete his quest, he will allow you to read a Psychology book.
For players that do not want to go back to the island to learn Psychology,
Yetta
sells a book titled
Fighting with Psychology
. Alternatively completing the "alternative approach to continued slaughter..." for
Oritania
's quest
Kill Spiders
will award Psychology experience and unlock it.
Helena Veilmoor
and
Suspicious Cow
teach
You Were Adopted
1-3 and
But I Love You
1-2
Nissim
in
Amulna
will unlock Psychology 51-60, 61-70, and teaches level 51+ abilities.
Raina
unlocks 71-80.
Levels 81-90 are unlocked by
Emersil the Ever-Gloating
deep beneath
Povus
.
